reviewer: GPT-6 Astra, separate read-only primary-source research context
scope: Targeted prior-art and evidentiary-standard review, not an exhaustive novelty or patent search.
conclusion: Executable program variation, inherited evolutionary search, mutation-prompt evolution, and self-improving scaffolds have substantial prior art. A distinctive RAPP/1 implementation or measured advantage remains a hypothesis, not a result of this pilot.

sources.title: Cargo Cult Science
sources.relevance: Disclose competing explanations and evidence that could invalidate the interpretation; publish unfavorable outcomes and enable others to judge the work.
sources.boundary: This is an application of his published scientific-integrity standard, not a claim about what would personally have convinced him.

sources.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
sources.reading_locations: Author manuscript PDF positions 3-6, 17-18, 28-29, including cover.
sources.relevance: Frozen-model program proposals, actual evaluation, inherited candidate context, independent islands, asynchronous search, and a repeated-generation-without-evolution ablation.
sources.access_note: The publisher URL returned HTTP 406 during review; the author-hosted manuscript identifying the Nature DOI was read.

sources.title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement Via Prompt Evolution
sources.relevance: Task prompts and the mutation prompts that govern their modification evolve together.

sources.title: Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP): Recursively Self-Improving Code Generation
sources.relevance: An executable program improver is applied to its own scaffolding under downstream utility and resource bounds.
sources.boundary: Scaffold improvement is distinguished from full recursive self-improvement because the language model remains unchanged.

sources.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
sources.relevance: Whole-code evolution, co-evolving intermediate solutions and search algorithms, and meta-prompt evolution in a separate database.
sources.boundary: The no-meta-prompt ablation reported for tensor decomposition is directly relevant prior art, not a universal guarantee for every software task.

sources.title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
sources.relevance: Coding agents modify their own code, are evaluated, and enter an archive that can supply later parents. Fixed-modifier and no-archive controls are reported.
sources.boundary: The outer archive/selection process remains fixed. Documented fabricated tool/test logs and objective hacking reinforce the need for an external evaluator.

sources.title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
sources.relevance: Adaptively reused evaluation data can itself become an optimization target; keep an untouched final audit unless a justified reusable-holdout method is implemented.

minimum_comparisons: Independent best-of-N versus inherited fixed-lens search.
Inherited fixed-lens versus inherited co-evolving-lens search.
If speculative wording is itself claimed to help, cross prompt policy with the search architecture.
Evaluate evolved and baseline lenses on common unseen parent programs to separate lens productivity from hitchhiking with a strong program.
Measure RAPP representation/provenance benefits separately from solver-performance claims.
accounting: Count all proposal, lens, critique, summary, retry, repair, evaluation, archive, audit, and replication costs; retain resource vectors rather than treating client request count as total compute.
replication: Distinguish replay of disclosed artifacts from an independent fresh stochastic search using independently authored audit tasks.
publication_standard: Publish outcomes regardless of the winning arm; a wide uncertainty interval is inconclusive, not equivalence or permission to claim benefit.
